node.title: Ask Me Anything: Marketing Analytics with PyMC Labs Experts
node.description:
Bring your toughest marketing analytics questions to two PyMC Labs principal data scientists. There are no slides and no prepared talk: **this hour is an open Ask Me Anything**, and the agenda is whatever you ask, from marketing mix modeling (MMM) and model validation to budget allocation and measuring incrementality.

The session works the way our Expert Access Program (EAP) works with client teams: you bring the problem, and our experts work through it with you. It is the first of a monthly series of open sessions with PyMC Labs experts.

**Who should attend**

* Marketing analytics and data science teams building or running an
* MMM Marketing and finance leaders who use MMM results to set budgets
* Teams weighing Bayesian MMM or PyMC-Marketing for their measurement stack

**💼 About the speakers:**
**Teemu Säilynoja (Principal Data Scientist at PyMC Labs)**
Teemu Säilynoja is a data scientist with expertise in Bayesian modeling, marketing analytics and trading analytics. He is completing a Doctor of Science degree focused on calibration assessment of Bayesian models. He also contributes to open-source tools for probabilistic programming and model evaluation in Python and R.
**Connect with Teemu:** [👉 LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/teemu-sailynoja/)

**Timothy McWilliams** (**Principal Data Scientist at PyMC Labs)**
With over 7 years of experience in the marketing mix modeling and marketing analytics space, Tim specializes in applying Bayesian modeling techniques to solve complex business challenges and uncover actionable insights. Passionate about bridging advanced statistical methods with real-world marketing strategy, he has worked across diverse industries to optimize media investments and measure impact.

**Connect with Tim:** [ 👉 LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tim-mcwilliams-a4b647b3)

node.description:
**\*TO ATTEND GET TICKETS AT**: [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/autumn-glow-party-cocktails-connections-tickets-2004187920020?aff=oddtdtcreator&keep_tld=true](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/autumn-glow-party-cocktails-connections-tickets-2004187920020?aff=oddtdtcreator&keep_tld=true)
(Limited # of ladies save $5 by using the discount code 5 at checkout. This event is being co-organized and promoted by multiple groups. This page only shows a very small portion of the actual attendees. Based on pre-sales, we expect to have a good # attending.)
Imagine walking into a room and instantly spotting people you already have something in common with—before you even say a word. That’s what makes our Glow Party such a fun, relaxed way to meet people in NYC.
Join up to 100 friendly members and guests from a variety of social groups for a night designed to make coming solo feel comfortable, natural, and fun. Whether you’re looking to make friends, expand your social circle, network, or simply enjoy a great night out, this event is all about connection—your way.
Finally a party where you will meet others who are interested in the same things as you before you even say a word! This a fun and unique way to navigate the social scene! We use our glow bracelet color coding system as just one of the ways for you to identify and instantly connect with others who have the same interests as you!
How it works:
**We will have 6 different colored glow bracelets at the check in table. Each bracelet represents something that you are interested in (Green=outdoor activities, Red=singles events, Blue=arts/culture, Yellow=travel, etc). You will choose up to 3 colors that best represent things that interest you.**
What to expect:

* **Tri-state professionals looking to mix, mingle, and connect**
* **We will have a private area reserved exclusively for our party**
* **Ice breaker games with prizes**
* **Our color coded system for finding like minded people**
* **Hosts on hand to welcome you and introduce you to others**
* **Music played at conversational levels**
* **Full food & drink menu available including speciality drink specials**

FAQs:
**Can I come alone?** Most come on their own. If you don't know anyone, the ice-breakers will help you meet others. Come alone or bring a friend - either way you'll feel comfortable and have a great time.
**How many members will be attending?** This is a multi-Meetup group event. This page only shows a very small portion of the actual attendees.
**Is there a dress code?** No hats, sweats, t-shirts etc. Jeans ok.
**Ages?** All welcome 21 and over.
For more fun events follow: [https://www.eventbrite.com/o/new-york-city-social-events-10797526283](https://www.eventbrite.com/o/new-york-city-social-events-10797526283)
